title: Recover from merge conflicts safely
description: Detect supported merge conflicts and provide clear resolution, continue, and abort flows without losing the user's work.
acceptanceCriteria: Conflicted paths and operation state come from Git and are clearly identified.
Users can inspect conflict content and use supported resolution/continue/abort actions.
Unsupported conflict forms are preserved and explained; no automatic resolution is presented as user-approved.
Tests cover conflict success, abort, stale state, and failure without destructive cleanup.

steps.description: Inspect conflict support in the selected engine
steps.details: Document supported merge/rebase states and limitations.

steps.description: Implement the bounded conflict recovery workflow
steps.details: Do not add AI or silent conflict resolution.
Test supported and unsupported conflicts plus abort/continue behavior.

technicalNotes: Never overwrite conflict markers or files without an explicit user action.
